stepInstructions: Open /src20 with the transfer action. The workspace shows its form with the action preselected.
Fill the form fields. Every field shows the values that drive the quote; the fixture environment has no live fees, and the app says so.
The end of the form holds the fee and review sections. Nothing is signed in this capture environment; the live app shows its own review here.
